about.title: The Story Behind Every Knot
about.intro: Every strand of yarn tells a story of patience, creativity, and a warm human touch. At Taliwastra, we believe handmade crafts are more than objects; they are a piece of the heart made real.
about.visi_desc: Bringing imagination to life through high-quality crochet art. We aspire to create characters and stories that bring smiles and comfort to every home, celebrating uniqueness in every design.
about.proses_desc: Every Taliwastra piece is 100% handmade. Made with love and meticulous care, we ensure no two works are ever exactly the same.
about.berkelanjutan_desc: We are committed to eco-friendly practices. Every chosen material and production process is considered to minimize environmental impact.
about.bahan_desc: We only use premium materials, prioritizing comfort and durability. Our main material, the soft and safe Balinese Cotton, is specially chosen to ensure every hug feels warm.
